subject: Throughput spike → error-rate increase & request for preserved runtime logs
messages:
From: ops@ledgerbank.com (Tom Li)
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Latency spike + 5xx error surge — need preserved logs

Ben / Monica,

We started seeing a sustained throughput spike around 2026-10-14T08:45:00Z which coincided with a jump in 5xx responses from the inference endpoint. Customer-facing impact: elevated latency (p95 from ~180ms to ~1.1s) and an error-rate increase from 0.3% to ~3.8% for ~20 minutes.

We need two things ASAP: 1) confirmation that Redwood will preserve all runtime artifacts from the 08:40–09:10 UTC window (logs, per-request traces, KV-cache snapshots, and any generated telemetry), and 2) a chain-of-custody statement describing how those artifacts will be handled, who will access them, and retention/replication steps.

LedgerBank's security team may request a formal custody package for audit. Please reply with the contact you will assign and the expected ETA for a preserved artifact bundle. If you need any PO/contract routing to enable a legal hold, let me know.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Li
Director of Ops, LedgerBank
attachments: none

Tom — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. I'm assigning this as a high-priority incident on our side. Quick answers up front: we will preserve the artifacts for the 08:40–09:10 UTC window and will produce a custody package.

Internal note / ask to the team: Monica & Marissa — can you confirm the customer's preference for delivery (S3 pre-signed, secure Share, or on-demand transfer to their vault)? Aditya — we need immediate guidance on the exact artifacts we will pull and whether we should snapshot KV caches. Also please confirm who from Engineering/Security will own the chain-of-custody export.

Tom — I'll get an ETA in the next 25–30 minutes and follow up with a named owner. If LedgerBank needs an NDA/PO to enable legal hold escalation, say the word and we'll prioritize legal.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Cc: ops@ledgerbank.com (Tom Li)
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Latency spike + 5xx error surge — need preserved logs

Adding a short mutual action plan so expectations are clear (attached):
- Preserve runtime logs (app logs + request traces) for 2026-10-14T08:40:00Z → 2026-10-14T09:10:00Z
- Snapshot telemetry and KV cache state at 08:50:00Z (best-effort point-in-time)
- Produce chain-of-custody manifest (who, what, when, where) and MD5 checksums for artifacts
- Delivery preference: pre-signed S3 by default; can do secure SFTP by request
- Retention: hold for 90 days by default unless LedgerBank requests a different window

Tom — please confirm S3 works for you and confirm any additional fields LedgerBank needs in the manifest (e.g., IP ranges, requester identity).

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_LedgerBank.docx
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@ledgerbank.com (Tom Li)
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Latency spike + 5xx error surge — need preserved logs

Ben / Monica — engineering runbook below. I'll own the artifact export and will hand off to Security for the formal custody package. ETA: initial tarball with artifacts in ~90 minutes, full validated package in ~6 hours (depends on audit sampling).

Artifacts we will capture (scope):
- Inference-serving application logs (stdout/stderr) for the pod set serving LedgerBank's model; time range 2026-10-14T08:30:00Z → 2026-10-14T09:30:00Z
- Request/response traces (Jaeger/OpenTelemetry spans) for the same time range
- Per-request metadata (request IDs, model variant, route config, batch id) — sanitized to remove PII where present
- KV cache snapshot (best-effort); if a binary snapshot is unavailable, we will include cache metrics and partial dumps
- Runtime telemetry (GPU utilization, host metrics, kernel metrics)
- Router / policy logs (routing decisions, fallback triggers)

Storage plan and chain-of-custody:
- Artifacts will be staged to a locked S3 bucket in our audit account (s3://redwood-incidents/LDG-4791/) with access limited to:
  - aditya_rao@redwood.ai (engineering owner)
  - security_incidents@redwood.ai (security ops mailbox)
  - ben_carter@redwood.ai (account owner)
- Each artifact will be hashed (SHA256) and the manifest will include filename, size, hash, capture timestamp, and capture node host-id
- We will generate an access log snapshot demonstrating who accessed the S3 prefix and when (will be part of the custody package)

PII note: we'll scrub any direct user PII from request payloads before inclusion. If LedgerBank requires full payloads for forensic purposes, we'll need an approved legal exception; otherwise we'll provide redacted payloads plus the full audit metadata.

Stubs attached for reference: runtime-telemetry-sample.json.

— Aditya Rao
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime & Observability, Redwood Inference
attachments: runtime-telemetry-sample.json
From: security@ledgerbank.com (LedgerBank Security)

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Latency spike + 5xx error surge — need preserved logs

Ben / Aditya / Monica,

Thanks for the immediate engagement and the plan. Two quick clarifications before we accept the custody package: 1) Confirm the retention window for the preserved artifacts (Monica suggested 90 days) and whether Redwood will honor a legal hold override up to 2 years if requested by LedgerBank's counsel; 2) Confirm that access to the S3 prefix will be restricted to the named Redwoods and will require MFA; if Redwood's security team will produce an audit of all accesses (object-level logs) as part of the package.

For traceability please include the original request IDs tied to the affected customer requests — we need those for our internal mapping. If any of the artifacts include API keys or credentials (we hope not), annotate those files and ensure they are redacted before delivery.

Please reply with the confirmation and an updated ETA for the custody package delivery. Forwarding the prior thread for context.

--
LedgerBank Security Team
